title: Spanish Shrimp Fideua
description: A seafood twist on the classic Spanish paella dish, made with fideua noodles, succulent shrimp, and warm Mediterranean flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the diced tomato, chicken broth, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the fideua noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the seafood and sauce.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the noodles are cooked through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the Spanish shrimp fideua hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
